verses.ar: لَيْسَ لَنَا يَارَبُّ لَيْسَ لَنَا، لَكِنْ لِٱسْمِكَ أَعْطِ مَجْدًا، مِنْ أَجْلِ رَحْمَتِكَ مِنْ أَجْلِ أَمَانَتِكَ.
verses.kjv: Not unto us, O LORD, not unto us, but unto thy name give glory, for thy mercy, [and] for thy truth’s sake.
verses.web: Not to us, Yahweh, not to us, but to your name give glory, for your loving kindness, and for your truth’s sake.

verses.kjv: Wherefore should the heathen say, Where [is] now their God?
verses.web: Why should the nations say, “Where is their God, now?”

verses.ar: إِنَّ إِلَهَنَا فِي ٱلسَّمَاءِ. كُلَّمَا شَاءَ صَنَعَ.
verses.kjv: But our God [is] in the heavens: he hath done whatsoever he hath pleased.
verses.web: But our God is in the heavens. He does whatever he pleases.

verses.ar: أَصْنَامُهُمْ فِضَّةٌ وَذَهَبٌ، عَمَلُ أَيْدِي ٱلنَّاسِ.
verses.kjv: Their idols [are] silver and gold, the work of men’s hands.
verses.web: Their idols are silver and gold, the work of men’s hands.

verses.ar: لَهَا أَفْوَاهٌ وَلَا تَتَكَلَّمُ. لَهَا أَعْيُنٌ وَلَا تُبْصِرُ.
verses.kjv: They have mouths, but they speak not: eyes have they, but they see not:
verses.web: They have mouths, but they don’t speak. They have eyes, but they don’t see.

verses.ar: لَهَا آذَانٌ وَلَا تَسْمَعُ. لَهَا مَنَاخِرُ وَلَا تَشُمُّ.
verses.kjv: They have ears, but they hear not: noses have they, but they smell not:
verses.web: They have ears, but they don’t hear. They have noses, but they don’t smell.

verses.ar: لَهَا أَيْدٍ وَلَا تَلْمِسُ. لَهَا أَرْجُلٌ وَلَا تَمْشِي، وَلَا تَنْطِقُ بِحَنَاجِرِهَا.
verses.kjv: They have hands, but they handle not: feet have they, but they walk not: neither speak they through their throat.
verses.web: They have hands, but they don’t feel. They have feet, but they don’t walk, neither do they speak through their throat.

verses.ar: مِثْلَهَا يَكُونُ صَانِعُوهَا، بَلْ كُلُّ مَنْ يَتَّكِلُ عَلَيْهَا.
verses.kjv: They that make them are like unto them; [so is] every one that trusteth in them.
verses.web: Those who make them will be like them; yes, everyone who trusts in them.

verses.ar: يَا إِسْرَائِيلُ، ٱتَّكِلْ عَلَى ٱلرَّبِّ. هُوَ مُعِينُهُمْ وَمِجَنُّهُمْ.
verses.kjv: O Israel, trust thou in the LORD: he [is] their help and their shield.
verses.web: Israel, trust in Yahweh! He is their help and their shield.

verses.ar: يَا بَيْتَ هَارُونَ، ٱتَّكِلُوا عَلَى ٱلرَّبِّ. هُوَ مُعِينُهُمْ وَمِجَنُّهُمْ.
verses.kjv: O house of Aaron, trust in the LORD: he [is] their help and their shield.
verses.web: House of Aaron, trust in Yahweh! He is their help and their shield.

verses.ar: يَا مُتَّقِي ٱلرَّبِّ، ٱتَّكِلُوا عَلَى ٱلرَّبِّ. هُوَ مُعِينُهُمْ وَمِجَنُّهُمْ.
verses.kjv: Ye that fear the LORD, trust in the LORD: he [is] their help and their shield.
verses.web: You who fear Yahweh, trust in Yahweh! He is their help and their shield.

verses.ar: ٱلرَّبُّ قَدْ ذَكَرَنَا فَيُبَارِكُ. يُبَارِكُ بَيْتَ إِسْرَائِيلَ. يُبَارِكُ بَيْتَ هَارُونَ.
verses.kjv: The LORD hath been mindful of us: he will bless [us;] he will bless the house of Israel; he will bless the house of Aaron.
verses.web: Yahweh remembers us. He will bless us. He will bless the house of Israel. He will bless the house of Aaron.

verses.ar: يُبَارِكُ مُتَّقِي ٱلرَّبِّ، ٱلصِّغَارَ مَعَ ٱلْكِبَارِ.
verses.kjv: He will bless them that fear the LORD, [both] small and great.
verses.web: He will bless those who fear Yahweh, both small and great.

verses.ar: لِيَزِدِ ٱلرَّبُّ عَلَيْكُمْ، عَلَيْكُمْ وَعَلَى أَبْنَائِكُمْ.
verses.kjv: The LORD shall increase you more and more, you and your children.
verses.web: May Yahweh increase you more and more, you and your children.

verses.ar: أَنْتُمْ مُبَارَكُونَ لِلرَّبِّ ٱلصَّانِعِ ٱلسَّمَاوَاتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ.
verses.kjv: Ye [are] blessed of the LORD which made heaven and earth.
verses.web: Blessed are you by Yahweh, who made heaven and earth.

verses.ar: ٱلسَّمَاوَاتُ سَمَاوَاتٌ لِلرَّبِّ، أَمَّا ٱلْأَرْضُ فَأَعْطَاهَا لِبَنِي آدَمَ.
verses.kjv: The heaven, [even] the heavens, [are] the LORD’s: but the earth hath he given to the children of men.
verses.web: The heavens are Yahweh’s heavens, but he has given the earth to the children of men.

verses.ar: لَيْسَ ٱلْأَمْوَاتُ يُسَبِّحُونَ ٱلرَّبَّ، وَلَا مَنْ يَنْحَدِرُ إِلَى أَرْضِ ٱلسُّكُوتِ.
verses.kjv: The dead praise not the LORD, neither any that go down into silence.
verses.web: The dead don’t praise Yah, nor any who go down into silence,

verses.ar: أَمَّا نَحْنُ فَنُبَارِكُ ٱلرَّبَّ مِنَ ٱلْآنَ وَإِلَى ٱلدَّهْرِ. هَلِّلُويَا.
verses.kjv: But we will bless the LORD from this time forth and for evermore. Praise the LORD.
verses.web: but we will bless Yah, from this time forward and forever more. Praise Yah!
